VERIFIED IN THE BPS-PATCHED GAME

Kitsune Attacks! · Round 10-4

The trick is to prepare a return staircase, place a spare block above a three-block bridge, and then lower that bridge while standing underneath it. Once it falls one row, climb up from the right and push the spare block left into the flame.

Watch the full videoRead the complete input listFCEUX replay

Start from a fresh 10-4. Each instruction is one separate button press; release and let the action finish. Turns count as presses. B uses the wand. Every image below shows the game after that press. Use the keyboard’s left/right arrows to browse.

Chapter inputs
The replay uses 346 separate presses. The patched ROM’s CRC32 is F0500A8F. The supplied .nes was the unpatched base; apply the supplied .bps first, or use the separately generated verified ROM.
Verification and replay instructions

This walkthrough was produced by local puzzle search and verified with ordinary controller input in FCEUX. All 256 puzzle actions were checked against the native game; the flame count reached zero. The saved FM2 was then replayed independently and cleared the level again.

For the replay, open ../.hack10-4/Kitsune-Attacks-BPS-verified.nes in FCEUX, then open hack-10-4.fm2 through the movie replay dialog. The movie includes its starting savestate. A standalone starting state is also included as 10-4-start.fcs.

The older files in ../solution/ describe the original, unpatched level. Use this guide for the hack.
